QuestInfo.name: Front Line Shield Soldiers
QuestInfo.1: You need to push the front all the way to where the Specter Shieldbearers are forming a scrummage in order to completely secure the route.\r\n#r(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You pushed back the front! Talk to Edea about the next mission.

1.0: Looks like the Specter Shieldbearers were no problem for you. Your efforts went a long way to securing the front line.\r\n

yes.0: There's still plenty to do here. Talk to me again.\r\n

default.0: Specter Shieldbearers are tough, but their attacks are weak. It won't be too difficult.\r\n#r(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k\r\n
